header: What you get with one install
subheadline: Each tile shows Desiderio at work in a seeded TYPO3 site, from inline editing to the mobile view.

items.title: Edit on the page itself
items.description: In the Visual Editor, editors change the page they see, with the live theme. Click, type, publish.
